finding: No in-game tutorial; opening is a stage-0 portal ring (12 s no-input lock, 23 s window) where the starter pick forces a default if idle and also sets the region, then a fixed winnable 2-Magikarp fight at stage 1; 3 starting boosters, but account XP and boosters only from games reaching stage 10 with 2+ players (main drop-off risk).

No tutorial and no progression; opt-in clock (150 s bank plus 60 s grace, +25 s per turn non-singles, 20 s re-enable cooldown) and first battle is a random team; onboarding is text the player asks for (/intro, /smogintro); client screens not in the box (not read).
